why: HOOK + thumbnail. Kyungbock High, exam morning 2014: a cheer leader mid-air with drums, and the test-site banner behind him. Representative asked for the crush at the exam-hall gate instead of generic city footage — this is that, and it is the frame the thumbnail card sits on.
'half a million teenagers sit down for one exam' — elevated view of the whole gate scene. Native portrait 2832x4165, so the 9:16 window is nearly the entire photograph.
'the whole country goes quiet for them' — a Seoul business-district intersection
'no horns within two hundred metres of a school' — the packed street outside the school gate, broadcast crane in shot
'the stock market opens an hour late so the roads stay clear' — roads
'twenty-five minutes of English listening' — the required 컴퓨터용 사인펜, the exact object
'where you land shapes what comes next' — a Korean university building, used exactly once
'about three in every ten in that room are sitting it again' — students at the gate, and the sign in frame literally reads SKY, the university tier the whole day is aimed at
PAYOFF — parents behind the railings, one man mid-prayer. No card over this cut.
outro bed, so the payoff cut stays clean. Same source as cut 3, 940 frames earlier, different offset and opposite pan.
